summary: Iteration 2 verification. YOUTUBE_API_KEY is now configured; backend search is paginated. All 8 backend tests pass (100%) including Create->Get-like pagination verification (page 1 vs page 2 return different videoIds). All 5 new frontend features work end-to-end at the public URL: (1) search Load More appends 19 new unique cards (24 -> 43, no duplicates); (2) Queue reorder up/down swaps rows correctly and first-up / last-down are properly disabled; (3) Close/Back (close-video-btn) stops video and returns to home-screen with control-bar hidden; (4) Share button is present in control bar and clickable without errors (clipboard path); (5) Ultra-wide handling: at 1920x1080, 2560x1080, 1920x960 and 1920x640 the video-player-container fills the viewport, there is NO horizontal scroll, control-bar stays within the viewport, and #yt-player is an IFRAME. Fit mode switching Fit/Fill/Crop updates the iframe stage size without errors (Fit=1920x1080 letterboxed on 21:9, Fill=2560x1440, Crop=2560x1613).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend search endpoint cleanly returns SearchResponse {items, nextPageToken}; invalid pageToken does not 500 (returns 4xx) — good defensive handling.
Frontend load-more de-duplication appears correct — repeated clicks would be worth stress-testing in a future iteration (clicking 3+ times) but current spec met.
QueueDrawer disables boundary buttons correctly; drag handles present. Consider adding aria-labels for a11y on the up/down icon-only buttons.
VideoPlayer computeStage handles 16:9, 21:9, 2:1 and 3:1 without horizontal overflow in all three fit modes — looks solid.
Prior iteration's key-banner z-index bug is no longer reachable (banner only renders when API key is missing, and it is now configured). No regression observed.
seed_data_creation: Frontend test used the 3-item LocalStorage queue from the review request (jNQXAC9IVRw, dQw4w9WgXcQ, 9bZkp7q19f0) plus cpyt:visited=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public url> pytest backend/tests/test_youtube_api.py. #yt-player gets REPLACED by the iframe (same id) — check document.getElementById('yt-player').tagName==='IFRAME'. All data-testids used by the review are present: home-search-btn, search-input, search-results, load-more-btn, search-result-*, header-queue-btn, queue-item-*, queue-up-{i}, queue-down-{i}, queue-drag-{i}, close-video-btn, control-bar, player-tap-layer, share-btn, settings-btn, fit-mode-fit/fill/crop, video-player-container, home-screen.
